goal: Return compliant error replies instead of crashing on malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests
Ensure invalid requests lacking an ID return error replies instead of being silenced as notifications
agreement: Strong support for fixing the crash and restoring spec-compliant error replies (ryanofsky, fametrano)

why: P2 because it fixes an assertion crash in debug builds triggered by malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests
It resolves spec violations where release builds return HTTP 400 instead of proper error payloads
It prevents invalid batch requests without an id from being silently dropped as notifications
